---
title: "Problem Health"
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<div class="health-summary" id="health-summary"></div>
<div class="health-table-wrap">
  <table class="health-table">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th>Problem</th>
        <th>Status</th>
        <th>Variables</th>
        <th>Questions</th>
        <th>Variants</th>
        <th>Notes</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody id="health-table-body"></tbody>
  </table>
</div>

<script src="../data/problem-health.js"></script>
<script>
const health = window.PROBLEM_HEALTH || [];
const summary = document.getElementById("health-summary");
const body = document.getElementById("health-table-body");
const okCount = health.filter((item) => item.status === "OK").length;
const reviewCount = health.length - okCount;

summary.innerHTML = `
  <div class="health-card">
    <strong>${health.length}</strong>
    <span>Total problems</span>
  </div>
  <div class="health-card">
    <strong>${okCount}</strong>
    <span>OK</span>
  </div>
  <div class="health-card">
    <strong>${reviewCount}</strong>
    <span>Needs review</span>
  </div>
`;

body.innerHTML = health.map((item) => `
  <tr>
    <td>
      <strong>${item.title}</strong><br>
      <code>${item.slug}</code>
    </td>
    <td><span class="health-status ${item.status === "OK" ? "ok" : "review"}">${item.status}</span></td>
    <td>${item.variables}</td>
    <td>${item.questions}</td>
    <td>${item.variants}</td>
    <td>${item.warnings.length ? item.warnings.join("<br>") : "No issues found"}</td>
  </tr>
`).join("");
</script>
```
